declarations.rationale: Warnings and sales have four rows each; warn is the largest individually repeated path (four), resolving the tie to directed communication.
Explicit president-of/attached president role paths dominate, distinct from corporate acquisition or coaching.
Support direct-object plus vote-for yields five clear support rows, ahead of press-to-addressee four. A generic give row is not automatically classified as either support or communication.
Travel-to and visit paths form the largest movement family, distinct from home/raised-in and professional roles.
Editor and edit-publication paths form the largest specific title/action family.
Accompanied/standing/arriving with wife paths dominate.
Writing in the named publication and critic-for paths dominate.
President, strongman and ruler-control constructions dominate the political institution-to-person family.
Remain-in, kept-in and movement statements form a coherent geographic-presence family. Modal/hypothetical moves cannot establish actual presence.
Internet company/market/site/analysis constructions form the dominant industry-domain family; Bell corporate lineage and physical White House presence are separate.

Corporate unit is the highest repeated individual path (two), among weak competing ownership, professional, membership and sports families. Unit direction is checked per case rather than combining child/parent roles.
Warnings, suggestions, conversation and letter-related communication form the dominant action family. Explicit president titles compete; generic give remains ambiguous without object.
Spokeswoman and speaking-for-office paths form the largest explicit coherent role family. Generic includes/choice political rows do not define membership automatically.
Play/beat/face/defeat at venue paths total six sporting-venue rows, ahead of generic travel/presence and legislative action.
Move-to/into paths dominate, with geographic departure and institutional membership competing.
Coach constructions plus guiding-team-fortunes form the largest coherent role family; advisers and geographic departure are competing meanings.
Disease, symptoms, exposure and death-from-disease form the largest coherent family, alongside chairperson office and journalism.
President, manager and executive-office constructions form the largest specific broad-office family; ownership and coaching alone remain distinct.
Award/win/received-prize constructions dominate over editorial titles; the award may be nonsporting.
Explicit director-of constructions form the largest specific role family, competing with inverse ministerial roles and dancing.
Diplomat-in, expatriate-in and firm-in form the largest location-presence family (four), ahead of artistic reviewing (three) and lobbying (two).
Died-at is overwhelmingly the dominant path; medical facilities are admissible physical death locations.

Ruler and president constructions form the strongest specific political-office family (three rows); other minister/official and personal-meeting meanings are not combined automatically. Weak mixed-family signal retained.
